dslRule:
<!id: collections.filterNullsOnAssignment>
<!description: Filter null elements from a List assigned to a field from a constructor parameter using streams and Objects.nonNull. This makes the field's list robust against potential null entries in the input list.>
<!severity: HINT>
$field = $param; :: isField($field) && isParameter($param) && instanceof($field, "java.util.List") && instanceof($param, "java.util.List")
=> $field = $param.stream().filter(java.util.Objects.nonNull).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList());
;;
summary: Filter nulls from a List assigned to a field from a constructor parameter.
